messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Getting subscript out of bounds exception while using dummies library in renjin
parts:
Hi Ravi, 
It looks like the dummies() function was passing the argument contrasts.arg = FALSE instead of contrasts.arg = NULL to the model.matrix function, which Renjin's implementation couldn't handle. I've added a check for this as it looks like contrasts.arg = FALSE became legal around R 2.15. Your example above now runs under Renjin 0.8.2326.

I took a look at some of the other examples from the dummy package that are failing under Renjin. In the remaining cases, however, it looks like since the package was first released in 2012, the dummy.data.frame no longer works in GNU R 3.3. We strive to stay compatible with the latest version of GNU R, so I would not expect this function to work under Renjin either. If you need this function, you can consider submitting a patch to the package's author.

Best,
Alex

When you say that "the issue remains same", do you mean that the latest release of Renjin doesn't fix your problem, or that GNU R and Renjin have the same problem?

If the latter is true, you might consider the "dummy" package, which is more recent and seems to function well under Renjin:
http://packages.renjin.org/package/org.renjin.cran/dummy

Best,
Alex

On Thu, Feb 16, 2017 at 2:25 PM Ravi Paramasivam <meetravip...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Alex,
  Thanks for the quick reply. I tried downloading the renjin-script-engine-0.8.2326-jar-with-dependencies.jar and ran the same examples with R3.3 release. The issue remains same. If dummy.data.frame doesn't work in R3.3 then can you suggest the alternative ways to achieve the same?

Regards
Ravi.P


On Thursday, February 16, 2017 at 4:42:25 PM UTC+5:30, Alexander Bertram wrote:
Hi Ravi, 
It looks like the dummies() function was passing the argument contrasts.arg = FALSE instead of contrasts.arg = NULL to the model.matrix function, which Renjin's implementation couldn't handle. I've added a check for this as it looks like contrasts.arg = FALSE became legal around R 2.15. Your example above now runs under Renjin 0.8.2326.

I took a look at some of the other examples from the dummy package that are failing under Renjin. In the remaining cases, however, it looks like since the package was first released in 2012, the dummy.data.frame no longer works in GNU R 3.3. We strive to stay compatible with the latest version of GNU R, so I would not expect this function to work under Renjin either. If you need this function, you can consider submitting a patch to the package's author.

Best,
Alex
